config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: SA
  factor: size
  neutral: neutral
  weighting: invvol
  tier: 3
  shortable: false
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 2000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 5.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 100000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: mcap_usd
        sign: -1
        log: true
    ranker:
      type: GroupNeutralRank
      params:
        inner:
          type: PercentileRank
          params:
            min_names: 5
        min_group_size: 5
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: GroupNeutralQuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        weighting: equal
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
        min_group_size: 5
        group_weight: names
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 63
    risk_weighting:
      type: InverseVol
      params:
        target_vol: 0.15
        floor: 0.08
        dollar_neutral: true
        group_neutral: true
        max_weight: 0.05
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: SA
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 10
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
